bullets.text: Architected a multi-agent Python pipeline delivering structured extraction from raw reviews into structured JSON, covering review-type classification, per-topic sentiment, evidence quotes, and staff-name linking for reporting dashboards, directly contributing to a 20% lift in client retention.

Lowered inference costs by implementing a two-tier routing architecture in Python: dispatched urgent single reviews to the Gemini API for low-latency responses, while directing large batch processing jobs to a self-hosted Gemma 27B model running on local GPU hardware.

Increased subcategory recall from 0.78 to 0.96 (F1 0.98) during model evaluation on a 500-review golden set of hard cases, then locked in accuracy gains with an automated regression test suite that re-runs on every change and fails the build.
Adopted by account managers using Python reporting tools to prepare for client meetings, providing per-dealer breakdowns that show dealership struggles to sharpen renewal and upsell conversations.
